accounting.rationale: The main sentence grants processor latitude to use mathematically equivalent expressions; the catalogue records the parentheses-integrity limit separately and does not require the latitude to be exercised.
Defines mathematical equivalence and warns that computational results can differ; it constrains oracles but is not itself a separate executable requirement.
Informative examples distinguishing computational from mathematical differences and pointing to integer division; no additional requirement or coverage claim is created.

Informative lists of allowable and forbidden alternative forms. The table-like extraction was checked row by row despite column interleaving; examples guide oracle limits but do not create local requirements.
Informative discussion of parentheses restricting alternative forms and possibly changing mathematical value; requirements are accounted under p2/p3 and 10.1.3.
Informative example that operand type can depend on evaluation order. It reinforces that tests must not infer grouping or operand evaluation order.
Processor latitude to evaluate a mathematically equivalent expression; no fixture may require, detect, or penalize a particular permitted rewrite.
Defines the equivalence relation used by the processor-latitude rule.
Defines an oracle limitation: mathematically equivalent numeric expressions can have different computational results.

requirements.title: Execution of numeric operations with results undefined by processor arithmetic is prohibited
requirements.source: 10.1.5.2.4 p1 first sentence; J3/24-007 PDF p177.
requirements.definition: A program shall not execute a numeric operation whose result is not defined by the arithmetic used by the processor.

pending.integer-division-by-zero-boundary: PENDING diagnostic/control source plan only for an executed integer division by zero when the processor arithmetic leaves the result undefined. The repair changes only the divisor to a nonzero value and uses an exact integer oracle; compile-time constant diagnostics and runtime signaling must be attributed carefully.
pending.integer-overflow-boundary: PENDING source-only plan for an integer operation whose mathematical result is outside the model range after independently establishing the range. The plan must not rely on wraparound, undefined reads, or compiler agreement.
pending.real-overflow-or-invalid-boundary: PENDING reviewer plan to classify real operations only when the processor arithmetic's defined/undefined status is established. IEEE infinities, NaNs, flags, or processor-dependent approximations must not be silently treated as this prohibition.

requirements.oracle: Negatives need exact source attribution to the executed numeric operation and independent proof that the result is not defined by the processor arithmetic. Positive controls must be identical except for the defining operand change and must use exact or otherwise portable results.
requirements.oracle_limitation: This source-only catalogue records pending plans only. It creates no Fortran test program, invokes no processor, approves no fixture or oracle, and claims no coverage. Future fixtures must use independently derived literal, inquiry, or source-relation oracles and must not infer evaluation order, short-circuiting, which operand was evaluated, or whether an operand was evaluated. They must not rely on compiler agreement, address arithmetic, TRANSFER, emitted assembly, undefined reads, or any numeric result that 10.1.5.2.4 permits to differ through mathematically equivalent rewriting. Floating-point tolerance is not an escape hatch for a value that is not portably determined.

requirements.title: Raising a negative real value to a real power is prohibited
requirements.source: 10.1.5.2.4 p1 second sentence; J3/24-007 PDF p177.
requirements.definition: A numeric operation that raises a negative real value to a real power is prohibited. This is separate from integer powers and from complex bases or powers.

pending.literal-negative-real-real-power: PENDING diagnostic/control source shape such as (-2.0)**0.5 only if the single defect is the negative real base with real exponent. The repair changes the base or exponent category and uses a portable nonnegative exact or type-only oracle.
pending.variable-negative-real-real-power: PENDING runtime/execution source plan where a REAL variable has a negative value before REAL exponentiation. The plan must establish execution and value without relying on undefined behavior or evaluation order.
pending.integer-power-separation: PENDING positive-control source shape showing a negative REAL value raised to a small INTEGER power is not this prohibition, with exact representable result such as (-2.0)**2 == 4.0. Do not assert internal exponent conversion.

requirements.oracle: Attribute only cases with real base value known negative and real exponent. Negative integer bases, integer exponents, and complex exponentiation belong to other requirements.
requirements.oracle_limitation: This source-only catalogue records pending plans only. It creates no Fortran test program, invokes no processor, approves no fixture or oracle, and claims no coverage. Future fixtures must use independently derived literal, inquiry, or source-relation oracles and must not infer evaluation order, short-circuiting, which operand was evaluated, or whether an operand was evaluated. They must not rely on compiler agreement, address arithmetic, TRANSFER, emitted assembly, undefined reads, or any numeric result that 10.1.5.2.4 permits to differ through mathematically equivalent rewriting. requirements.title: Numeric rewrite latitude is limited by mathematical equivalence and parentheses integrity
requirements.definition: After the interpretation of a numeric intrinsic operation is established, the processor may evaluate a mathematically equivalent expression only if the integrity of parentheses is not violated. Numeric expressions are mathematically equivalent when their mathematical values are equal for all possible values of their primaries, but mathematically equivalent numeric expressions can produce different computational results.

pending.parentheses-integrity-boundary: PENDING positive-control source plan with parenthesized integer operations whose interpreted value differs from an unparenthesized or reassociated form, citing 10.1.3 for grouping. The case observes parentheses integrity, not whether any rewrite was attempted.
pending.computational-difference-oracle-boundary: PENDING catalogue-review plan to reject future numeric value oracles whose expected result could be changed by an allowed mathematically equivalent rewrite. Tolerance comparisons do not rescue such facets; choose exact integer or otherwise rewrite-invariant values instead.

requirements.oracle: No fixture may require a processor to choose or reveal an alternative form. Parentheses tests must use source expressions where the standard interpretation is independently fixed and the expected result is not a floating value that a permitted rewrite could alter.

review_rationale: batch101: independent fresh-context source review against pinned J3/24-007 (sha256 7371e889...). Reviewer read every base unit of 10.1.5.2.1-10.1.5.2.4 and 10.1.5.3.1-10.1.5.3.2 in the original PDF, not the author summary, and verified 24 base / 42 fine units, 12 requirements and 45 facets (all pending), with 0 already-counted numbered units. Reviewer independently agreed with the zero-facet verdict for 10.1.5.3.2 (permission-only / oracle boundary, not absence of normative text) and with the handling of Tables 10.3 and 10.4 and the informative NOTE 2 alternative forms. Decision: source-eligible, no blocking findings; two non-blocking scope clarifications recorded as C10NR-NB1 and C10NR-NB2 in doc/source_audits/batch_101.json. This registers source accounting only: it is not fixture approval, not an execution result, and approves no concrete numeric or complex-power value oracle.
